references_examined.observation_fr: Modèle visible avec commandes périphériques; intérêt d'un éclairage permettant de juger les couleurs.
Visage dominant et catégories en marge; référence de composition uniquement, sans reprise des costumes ni de l'univers.

shared_scope_fr: Aventurier humain adulte débutant, épée simple, cour d'entraînement avec mannequin, marche basse et escalier. Ces illustrations ne fixent aucune nouvelle mécanique de jeu. Les tenues, visages et genres représentés sont des exemples, pas des restrictions de l'éditeur.
next_stage_fr: Choix explicite d'une direction par Izoka, puis langage visuel et interface, écran canonique, assets/prefabs et intégration moteur. Ne pas interpréter la génération de ces planches comme une validation visuelle.

directions.title: Les Hauts-Vents
directions.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original fantasy MMORPG art-direction board, for choosing a direction BEFORE any Unity implementation.
Create ONE cohesive premium art-director presentation board, wide landscape 16:9, high-resolution. This is concept art, not a gameplay screenshot, not a finished implemented game.
Use exactly the same comparison structure: thin elegant title strip at top; LEFT 32% a large FULL-BODY FRONT THREE-QUARTER adult human beginner adventurer on a plain background, small full-body BACK VIEW and a FACE DETAIL of that SAME character; RIGHT 68% a large elevated third-person environment view of a SMALL TRAINING SANDBOX. Bottom narrow strip contains a simple original sword, two readable tiny magic/attack effect studies, four material chips and five palette swatches, arranged like an artist's sketchbook, not application cards.
Character baseline across the comparison: adult human androgynous adventurer, athletic but ordinary, practical fully clothed beginner clothing, short-to-medium hair, approachable face, human proportions about 7 heads tall, ONE ordinary one-handed sword, no royal legendary armor. Clear readable body joints and silhouette that could later be translated into a simple modular 3D model.
Sandbox baseline: a modest 15-by-20-metre training courtyard, readable open flat movement space, ONE wooden practice dummy, ONE low jumping ledge, three shallow steps, a small sheltered character-creation alcove. Show the same character small from behind in the environment for scale. Distant architecture can suggest upward tower exploration without enlarging the playable area.
Rendering: plausible stylized 3D game asset forms with concept-art polish, deliberate flat material areas and broad shadows. Favor large shapes, a few removable outfit pieces, simple clustered hair, modest decoration. Keep character outfit consistent in all views. Environment playable floor and character must be clearly readable.
No UI windows, no HUD, no metrics, no dashboard, no card grid, no menus, no imported game mechanics, no existing franchise costumes or logos. Do not mimic Sword Art Online characters, famous black swordsmen, red-white knight uniforms, or another game's art direction. No sexualization, no photorealism, no chibi proportions, no excessive particle noise. No paragraphs, no invented microtext. French typography only, very few exact labels as specified.

Direction A — LES HAUTS-VENTS.
Visual thesis: an airy optimistic frontier where tower terraces are built like stone sailboats and climbing gardens. Fresh anime-inflected cel shading, clean sunny planes, expressive eyes, subtle hand-painted gradients. Strong daylight readability.
Character: warm brown skin, short tousled dark auburn hair, cropped IVORY canvas adventurer jacket with a CORAL diagonal cloth sash that ends at the hip, petrol-blue fitted trousers, light bronze practical shin guards and leather boots. Split angular jacket hem evokes a folded sail; no long cape. Simple pale steel sword with a crescent brass guard and coral fabric grip. Same outfit front and back. No crystal weapon.
Sandbox: sunlit limestone terrace, warm stone paving, a few blue-green wind-bent plants, small coral sailcloth canopy over the creation alcove, curved architectural ribs like hull frames. A distant original vertical stone tower made of offset garden terraces rises above clouds. Clear bounded small training court in foreground; leave movement area empty.
Shape language: tapered sail triangles, crescent cutouts, curved stone ribs. Materials: woven canvas, sun-warmed pale limestone, brushed bronze, petrol-blue leather. Palette: chalk ivory, coral, petrol blue, brass, clear sky blue. Warm light and cool crisp cast shadows.
Magic studies: a clean pale-gold crescent sword arc and three translucent blue tapered wind strokes; visual studies only.
Board background warm ivory, airy spacing. Exact top title "A — LES HAUTS-VENTS". Small exact labels "PERSONNAGE", "BAC À SABLE", "MATIÈRES".

Direction B — LES BRAISES D'ARGILE.
Visual thesis: a welcoming handmade fantasy where protective gear and magical objects are made from fired clay, woven fabric and copper. Tactile painterly stylized 3D, rounded chunky-but-human forms, visible restrained brushwork, broad warm lighting. Craft fantasy, not steampunk and not industrial factory.
Character: warm medium skin, short wavy almost-black hair tucked back, indigo quilted short tunic over cream linen trousers, terracotta-orange small removable glazed ceramic shoulder guard and simple ceramic knee plates, copper fasteners, short ocher waist apron tied to one side, sturdy brown ankle boots. Practical readable silhouette, no gigantic gloves. Sword has a plain iron blade, compact angular fired-clay guard with a cobalt-blue painted stripe, and leather grip. Consistent outfit across views.
Sandbox: intimate hexagonal warm terracotta courtyard in an abandoned artisan guild hall, low curved walls, one large dormant domed kiln tucked beside sheltered character alcove, overhead timber shade beams, cobalt-painted friezes limited to a few edges, shallow circular floor marks, one little fig tree at the perimeter. Evening sunlight from left but evenly readable terrain and skin. A stepped brick tower visible through the open arch, modest distant silhouette. Clear empty court in foreground.
Shape language: rounded hexagons, stitched bands, incised stamp marks. Materials: matte terracotta, glossy orange ceramic, rough cream linen, dark blue quilting, aged copper. Palette: burnt orange, ink indigo, cream, dull copper, soft ocher. Strong differentiation of matte cloth and glossy glaze.
Magic studies: controlled golden ember brushstroke around sword and a small clay-red geometric seal with a cobalt rim; visual studies only.
Board background pale clay parchment with tiny non-text pencil marks, unboxed editorial composition. Exact top title "B — LES BRAISES D'ARGILE". Small exact labels "PERSONNAGE", "BAC À SABLE", "MATIÈRES".

Direction C — L'ENCRE DES ASTRES.
Visual thesis: quiet mysterious tower fantasy expressed through dark inkstone, pale jade and celestial calligraphy. Graphic stylized 3D with crisp cel-shadow edges, restrained two-tone gradients, expressive anime-inspired adult faces. Beautiful legible dusk, not horror, not bleak desaturation.
Character: medium-deep skin, short straight silvery-gray hair with a blunt asymmetric fringe, close-fitting PLUM short jacket with a broad pale jade collar and a single short ivory mantle over one shoulder, charcoal loose cropped trousers tucked into dark boots, slim tarnished silver bracers. Distinct compact silhouette, asymmetry above the waist, no trench coat, no full black outfit. Plain satin-steel sword with small off-centre silver oval guard and a pale jade pommel, no huge blade. Keep clothing forms simple and consistent front and back.
Sandbox: small roofless basalt observatory courtyard with broad nearly black smooth stone tiles separated by sparse ivory inlays, shallow three-step dais, sheltered creation alcove under one truncated oblique stone arch, a still shallow reflective channel outside the movement court, distant tall monolithic tower with offset rectangular apertures. Overcast luminous twilight, pale atmospheric sky, enough soft front fill to see face, sword, clothes and terrain clearly. A few tall reeds only around boundary. Do not fill the scene with crystals.
Shape language: broken circles, ink-like tapered curves, oblique monoliths with clean cutouts. Materials: ink-dark basalt, pale jade ceramic, plum-dyed cloth, satin silver, translucent smoked glass. Palette: charcoal ink, pale jade, muted plum, ivory, soft silver.
Magic studies: one crisp ivory calligraphic sword slash and a small sparse jade orbital glyph, contained and readable, not dense runes; visual studies only.
Board background pale cool gray to make character silhouette and palette legible. Exact top title "C — L'ENCRE DES ASTRES". Small exact labels "PERSONNAGE", "BAC À SABLE", "MATIÈRES".
